verification_points.title: The RPC service does not wait for ongoing requests when it is shut down.
verification_points.requirement: When the session is closed, the RPC service should wait within the graceful shutdown window until all ongoing requests are completed before exiting.
verification_points.mutation: The complete implementation is the same as the reference implementation. Only the logic for stopping the RPC service, which currently has if active > 0, is changed to if false && active > 0. This allows skipping the waiting for ongoing requests. (changed files: torrent/session_rpc_server.go, among others)
verification_points.setup: Apply this patch (full implementation) on the clean baseline (commit 697380ffec04), and then run the tests/test.sh provided with the task for official scoring.
verification_points.expected_result: The task grader should reject the candidate because at least one assertion for this behavior fails. Acceptance indicates that the tests missed this specific defect. Focus: There are ongoing RPC requests when closing.
invalid_if: The patch does not apply to the task baseline (APPLY_FAILED).
The task image fails to build or the container environment fails (ENV_ERROR).
The tests produce no case-level report, fail to finish, or time out.
